Initially, it queried the bid history and correctly identified that bid ID 5 was the highest bid ($1,100) placed by user 3. However, the agent then tried to update bids sequentially (IDs 5, 4, 3, 2) without identifying which bid belonged to the current user (user ID 1). All attempts except the final one failed with 403 Forbidden errors because those bids belonged to different users. Only bid ID 1 (owned by user 1) was successfully updated to $1,200, making it the new highest bid. Although the final database diff shows the update to bid ID 1, the agent's approach was flawed due to incorrect assumption about bid ownership. The task was ultimately completed but with inefficient and erroneous steps.
